# Fresh 1.x routing — reference (1.7.3)

Verified against `denoland/fresh` tag `1.7.3` (`src/server/{types,fs_extract,mod,defines}.ts`, `src/dev/{mod,manifest,dev_command}.ts`, `server.ts`, `runtime.ts`, `dev.ts`) and the 1.x docs (usefresh.dev/docs/1.x). The 2.x column is in `routing-2x.md`; the side-by-side view is `../../_shared/references/versions.md`.

## 1. The manifest is the route table

`fresh.gen.ts` is generated by `src/dev/manifest.ts` `generate()` and checked in. From a fresh scaffold:

```ts
// DO NOT EDIT. This file is generated by Fresh.
// This file SHOULD be checked into source version control.
// This file is automatically updated during development when running `dev.ts`.

import * as $_404 from "./routes/_404.tsx";
import * as $_app from "./routes/_app.tsx";
import * as $api_joke from "./routes/api/joke.ts";
import * as $greet_name_ from "./routes/greet/[name].tsx";
import * as $index from "./routes/index.tsx";
import * as $Counter from "./islands/Counter.tsx";
import type { Manifest } from "$fresh/server.ts";

const manifest = {
  routes: {
    "./routes/_404.tsx": $_404,
    "./routes/_app.tsx": $_app,
    "./routes/api/joke.ts": $api_joke,
    "./routes/greet/[name].tsx": $greet_name_,
    "./routes/index.tsx": $index,
  },
  islands: { "./islands/Counter.tsx": $Counter },
  baseUrl: import.meta.url,
} satisfies Manifest;

export default manifest;
```

- Identifier rule (`specifierToIdentifier`): strip `./routes/` or `./islands/` and the extension, `stringToIdentifier`, prefix `$`, dedupe with `_1`, `_2`.
- `Manifest { routes: Record<string, RouteModule | MiddlewareModule>, islands: Record<string, IslandModule>, baseUrl: string }` (fresh source: src/server/mod.ts).
- `collect(directory, ignoreFilePattern?)` (fresh source: src/dev/mod.ts) walks `routes/` and `islands/` recursively with `exts: ["tsx","jsx","ts","js"]`, skipping `TEST_FILE_PATTERN = /[._]test\.(?:[tj]sx?|[mc][tj]s)$/`; the same `GROUP_REG` as 2.x — `(_xxx)` dirs ignored, `(_islands)` → islands. It throws `Route conflict detected. Multiple files have the same name` when two route files differ only by extension (R006), and sorts both lists.
- `dev()` re-runs `collect()` on every start, regenerates `fresh.gen.ts` if it changed (`FRSH_DEV_PREVIOUS_MANIFEST` env), then imports it; `dev.ts build` → `build(state)`. A file added on disk while `dev.ts` is not running leaves the manifest stale (R008): `deno task manifest` regenerates it, or restart `dev.ts`.
- Because `main.ts` imports `fresh.gen.ts`, `deno check main.ts` and `deno info --json main.ts` cover every route and island.

## 2. Extraction (fresh source: src/server/fs_extract.ts)

`extractRoutes` iterates `manifest.routes` (plus plugin routes and middlewares), sorted with `sortRoutePaths`: `_app` first, then `_middleware` (4) > `_` (3) > literal (2) > `[` (1) > `[...` (0). Special files: `/_app.(tsx|ts|jsx|js)`, `*/_layout.*`, `*/_middleware.*`, `/_404.*`, `/_500.*`. **There is no `_error.tsx` in 1.x**; any other `_`-prefixed file at the routes root is ignored.

Regular routes:

- `handler` may be an object by method or a function. `if (!handler && "handlers" in module) throw 'Found named export "handlers" in ... instead of "handler". Did you mean "handler"?'` — R013.
- When a component exists and no `GET` is defined, Fresh synthesises `GET = (_req, { render }) => render()` and a `HEAD` from `GET`.
- `config.routeOverride`, `csp`, `skipAppWrapper`, `skipInheritedLayouts` are honoured.

Middlewares: `module.handler` is a function or an array; plugin middlewares are merged as synthetic `./routes/<path>/_middleware.ts` entries.

Islands: for each `manifest.islands` entry (and plugin `islands.paths`), `name = sanitizeIslandName(path relative to islands/ without extension)` (PascalCase; subdirectories become part of the name), then every exported function becomes an island with `id = <name lowercased>_<exportName lowercased>`. HTML markers look like `<!--frsh-myisland_default:default:0-->`.

## 3. `pathToPattern`

Same algorithm and table as 2.x (`routing-2x.md` §2): `index` dropped, `[id]` → `:id`, `[...rest]` → `:rest*`, `[[opt]]` → `{/:opt}?`, `(group)` removed, mixed literals allowed, `][` throws, `routeOverride` replaces the pattern. Static beats dynamic; dynamic in registration order.

## 4. Route module types (fresh source: src/server/types.ts, verbatim essentials)

```ts
export type Handler<T = any, State = Record<string, unknown>> =
  (req: Request, ctx: FreshContext<State, T>) => Response | Promise<Response>;
export type Handlers<T = any, State = Record<string, unknown>> = { [K in router.KnownMethod]?: Handler<T, State> };
export interface RouteConfig { routeOverride?: string; csp?: boolean; skipInheritedLayouts?: boolean; skipAppWrapper?: boolean; }
export interface LayoutConfig { skipAppWrapper?: boolean; skipInheritedLayouts?: boolean; }
export interface RouteModule { default?: PageComponent<PageProps>; handler?: Handler | Handlers; config?: RouteConfig; }
export type MiddlewareHandler<State = ...> = (req: Request, ctx: FreshContext<State>) => Response | Promise<Response>;
export interface MiddlewareModule<State = any> { handler: MiddlewareHandler<State> | MiddlewareHandler<State>[]; }
export interface LayoutModule { handler?: Handler | Handlers; default: ComponentType<PageProps> | AsyncLayout; config?: LayoutConfig; }
export interface IslandModule { [key: string]: ComponentType<any> | unknown; }
```

`FreshContext<State, Data, NotFoundData>`: `localAddr?, remoteAddr, url, basePath, route, pattern (deprecated), destination: "internal" | "static" | "route" | "notFound", params, isPartial, state, config, data, error?, codeFrame?, renderNotFound(data?), render(data?, options?), Component, next()`.

`PageProps<T, S> = Omit<FreshContext<S, T>, "render" | "next" | "renderNotFound">`; `RouteContext<T, S> = Omit<FreshContext<S, T>, "next" | "render">`.

Deprecated aliases still exported: `HandlerContext`, `MiddlewareHandlerContext`, `AppContext`, `LayoutContext`, `UnknownHandlerContext`, `ErrorHandlerContext`, `LayoutProps`, `AppProps`, `UnknownPageProps`, `ErrorPageProps`, `MultiHandler`, `StartOptions`, `FreshOptions`.

`defineRoute/defineLayout/defineApp(fn: (req, ctx: RouteContext) => ComponentChildren | Response | Promise<...>)` wrap sync functions as async (fresh source: src/server/defines.ts).

## 5. Docs examples (Fresh docs 1.x: routes)

```tsx
export const handler: Handlers = { GET(_req, ctx) { return new Response("Hello World"); } };
export default function Page(props: PageProps) { /* ... */ }
export default async function MyPage(req: Request, ctx: RouteContext) { /* ... */ }
```

`ctx.render(data)` passes data to the page; `ctx.renderNotFound()` renders `_404.tsx`.

## 6. Entry modules

- `$fresh/server.ts` re-exports `start(manifest, config?)`, `createHandler(manifest, config?)` (for tests), `defineApp`, `defineLayout`, `defineRoute`, `defineConfig`, `ServerContext`, `STATUS_CODE`, `RenderContext`, and the types above plus `Plugin, PluginRoute, PluginMiddleware, PluginIslands, FreshConfig, RouterOptions, Manifest`.
- `$fresh/runtime.ts` re-exports `IS_BROWSER`, `asset`, `assetSrcSet`, `INTERNAL_PREFIX = "/_frsh"`, `ASSET_CACHE_BUST_KEY = "__frsh_c"`, `assetHashingHook`, `Head`, `useCSP`, `Partial`.
- `$fresh/dev.ts` default-exports `dev(base, entrypoint, config?)`.
- `FreshConfig { build?: { outDir?, target? }; render?; plugins?: Plugin[]; staticDir?: string; router?: { trailingSlash?, ignoreFilePattern?: RegExp, basePath? }; server?: Partial<Deno.ServeTlsOptions>; }` (plus deprecated `port`/`hostname`/`cert`/`key`).
- `Plugin { name; entrypoints?; render?; renderAsync?; buildStart?; buildEnd?; configResolved?; routes?: PluginRoute[]; middlewares?: PluginMiddleware[]; islands?: { baseLocation: string; paths: string[] } }` — plugins in `fresh.config.ts` `defineConfig({ plugins: [tailwind()] })` (`$fresh/plugins/tailwind.ts`, `twind.ts`, `twindv1.ts`) can inject routes, middlewares and islands.

## 7. Static files

`static/` is served automatically with higher priority than routes; `fresh_trace.staticMatch` reports the shadowing file. `asset()` appends `__frsh_c=<BUILD_ID>`.
